description.en: Single-plugin discover index for the DeepSeek Super-agent prototype (dsh-superagent).
description.zh: DeepSeek Super-agent 原型（dsh-superagent）专用单插件发现索引。

description.en: A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.
description.zh: 面向单个 GitHub 仓库的主动式 agent（DSH bundle）：监听 GitHub 与可选飞书，按策略评估请求，将已授权请求转为工单，并在各自 DSH 会话中执行。
